ABOUT WFP The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks. At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves. To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok. WHY JOIN WFP? WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate. WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment. WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities. A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe. We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement). BACKGROUND In July 2023, the World Food Programme (WFP) Zambia Country Office commenced a new five-year Country Strategic Plan (CSP) informed by and aligned with national and United Nations priorities and global commitments under the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It embraces the Government’s long-term Vision 2030; aligns with 16 key strategic areas of the 8th National Development Plan (NDP8); and contributes to the joint Zambia-United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF). WFP Zambia’s integrated and pragmatic CSP shifts away from unsustainable localized and micro-level interventions, to embrace more effective advocacy and engagement with national policies, systems, and programmes to achieve national impact on SDG2. Given the Government’s commitment to budget support for nutrition, social protection, and agriculture, despite the constraints in the country’s fiscal position, WFP’s overarching strategy seeks to enable the government to meet its national priorities with better systems, expertise, and resources for implementation. This means a decisive shift of WFP’s country positioning towards the provision of innovative, sustainable, upstream technical assistance for nationally owned solutions. Advancing the global WFP Strategic Plan (2026-2029), the Country Strategic Plan (CSP) addresses both SDG2 and SDG17 and is structured around three integrated strategic outcomes: (SO1) saving lives in crises; (SO2) reducing future humanitarian needs through resilience building; and (SO3) strengthening national systems and partner capacities. REPORTING AND PURPOSE OF THE ROLE The Logistics Officer reports to the Deputy Country Director and leads the logistics unit in the Country Office, providing strategic, technical, and operational leadership for logistics activities in support of WFP programmes, operations, and emergency response. The incumbent manages logistics staff and resources, ensuring the effective, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective delivery of logistics services, including transport, warehousing, and other supply chain support services. As head of the logistics unit, the incumbent is responsible for logistics planning, operational performance, resource management, risk mitigation, emergency preparedness, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role advises senior management on logistics strategies, operational risks, service delivery priorities, and resource requirements, while strengthening partnerships with government counterparts, UN agencies, cooperating partners, service providers, and other stakeholders to support WFP's operational and strategic objectives. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Lead and manage the logistics function, ensuring effective planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery of logistics services in support of WFP operations, programmes, and emergency response activities. Supervise, coach, and develop logistics staff, ensuring effective workload management, accountability, performance management, and professional development. Advise senior management on logistics strategies, operational priorities, risks, capacity requirements, and service delivery solutions to support organizational objectives and programme implementation. Develop and implement logistics workplans, service improvement initiatives, and performance monitoring mechanisms to ensure efficient, compliant, and client-focused service delivery. Plan, coordinate, and oversee logistics operations, including transport, warehousing, inventory management, commodity handling, and other supply chain activities, ensuring compliance with WFP policies, procedures, and standards. Monitor logistics performance and operational trends, analyse data, and provide recommendations to improve efficiency, cost-effectiveness, accountability, and service quality. Lead logistics risk management activities, including contingency planning, operational risk mitigation, and implementation of appropriate controls to safeguard WFP assets and operations. Lead logistics emergency preparedness activities and ensure readiness to support rapid emergency response, surge operations, and humanitarian interventions. Oversee logistics aspects of business continuity planning and ensure critical logistics services remain operational during emergencies, disruptions, or periods of increased operational demand. Manage logistics budgets, operational resources, assets, and staffing requirements, ensuring effective and efficient utilization of available resources. Lead logistics procurement planning and requirements definition, and oversee the management of logistics service contracts, transport agreements, warehousing arrangements, and vendor performance to ensure quality service delivery and value for money. Establish and maintain effective partnerships with government counterparts, UN agencies, cooperating partners, NGOs, commercial service providers, and other stakeholders to strengthen logistics coordination, interoperability, and operational effectiveness. Represent WFP in logistics coordination mechanisms, technical working groups, humanitarian logistics forums, and other relevant platforms, promoting collaboration, information sharing, and common approaches where appropriate. Lead the planning, management, and expansion of WFP's common logistics services and humanitarian logistics capabilities, including logistics hubs, on-demand service provision, and support to government and humanitarian partners during preparedness and response activities. Lead logistics capacity strengthening initiatives for WFP staff, government counterparts, cooperating partners, and other stakeholders to enhance national and organizational logistics capabilities. Coordinate logistics support for programme implementation, field operations, emergency responses, and special operations, ensuring services meet evolving operational requirements. Prepare management reports, analyses, and recommendations on logistics performance, operational risks, resource utilization, service delivery, and strategic priorities to support informed decision-making. Perform other related duties as required. Qualifications & Experience Required Education: Advanced University degree in Transport Economics, Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Management or other related field with one (1) year post graduate logistics experience in a humanitarian or related environment, or First University degree with three (3) additional years of related work experience and/or training/courses. Experience: Experience managing logistics and supply chain operations, including transport, warehousing, inventory management, and service delivery. Experience planning, coordinating, and monitoring logistics operations in humanitarian, development, commercial, or public-sector environments. Experience managing transport services, logistics contracts, customs clearance processes, and relationships with service providers and government authorities. Experience coordinating logistics activities with procurement, programme, supply chain, and external partners. Experience in emergency preparedness, contingency planning, and humanitarian response operations. Experience using logistics information systems, corporate applications, and data analysis tools to support planning, monitoring, and reporting. Knowledge & Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify risks and implement practical solutions. Strong planning, organizational, and resource management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and ensure continuity of operations. Strong leadership and people-management skills, including the ability to supervise, coach, develop, and motivate staff. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management, government counterparts, partners, and service providers. Ability to build capacity, promote knowledge sharing, and strengthen logistics capabilities among staff and partners. Sound understanding of logistics operations, supply chain management principles, emergency preparedness, and humanitarian response mechanisms. Ability to perform effectively under pressure and in emergency or rapidly changing operational environments. Languages: Fluency (level C) in English. review_candidates.title: Técnico/a de sistemas y DevOps (Linux, AWS)
review_candidates.description: Estamos evolucionando nuestra infraestructura en AWS hacia Terraform, Docker y despliegue automático desde GitLab. Buscamos a la persona que decida con nosotros cómo hacerlo y lleve a ese modelo los servicios que ya tenemos. Elektro3, en breve Desde 1993 distribuimos ferretería y material eléctrico a tiendas de más de 20 países: unas 28.000 referencias y 250 personas. El equipo de tecnología desarrolla en casa su propio software, de la tienda online a las herramientas internas. Producto propio, no consultora. Más sobre nosotros en elektro3.com. El puesto El rumbo de la plataforma nueva está decidido y escrito: Terraform para la infraestructura, contenedores Docker que se despliegan solos desde GitLab, bases de datos gestionadas por AWS y acceso individual para cada persona. Los dos primeros proyectos que van a ella ya están planificados. Lo que queda abierto es el cómo, y ahí entras tú: buscamos a alguien con oficio en sistemas que lo lleve a la práctica y lo mejore. Tu criterio va a pesar, y si algo se puede hacer mejor, se cambia. Al mismo tiempo, lo que ya existe da servicio a clientes cada día y hay que mantenerlo en marcha: servidores Debian con nginx, aplicaciones PHP con Laravel, MariaDB, PostgreSQL y RabbitMQ, en la nube y en servidores propios con Proxmox. Lo que tenga sentido se irá pasando a la plataforma nueva, poco a poco y sin romper nada. No vas a estar sin apoyo: hay guías escritas, y al principio los cambios importantes se revisan con el CTO. Con el tiempo, las decisiones de la plataforma pasan a ser tuyas. Lo que harás el primer año Revisar con nosotros el plan de la plataforma nueva y poner en marcha los primeros proyectos. Llevar servicios a contenedores en la plataforma nueva, y retirar los servidores que dejen de hacer falta. Responder a los fallos de seguridad graves: saber en horas a qué servidores afectan, protegerlos mientras tanto y actualizarlos. Mantener copias de seguridad con restauración probada, y alertas con un responsable claro. Gestionar los accesos por persona, revisados y documentados. Simplificar la infraestructura, con el gasto medido. Cómo trabajamos Las decisiones se hablan en equipo. Si ves algo que se puede hacer mejor, dilo: se escucha igual lleves una semana o diez años. Documentamos mientras trabajamos, en el repositorio. Lo que no está escrito, para nosotros no existe. La IA es parte del día a día, con normas claras sobre lo que puede tocar y lo que no. Nada de lo que propone la IA se aplica sin que una persona lo lea antes. Lo que buscamos Imprescindible: Tres años o más gestionando servidores Linux y nginx en producción, en sistemas o como DevOps, no en soporte a usuarios. Mantener servidores actualizados y saber qué hacer con un aviso de seguridad: a qué afecta, qué se mitiga mientras tanto y cómo se comprueba. Experiencia práctica con AWS: servidores, redes y permisos (EC2, VPC, IAM). Docker, y experiencia básica con integración continua (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions o similar). IA en tu trabajo diario, y criterio para revisar lo que te devuelve. Costumbre de documentar lo que haces. Se valora: Experiencia con Terraform, OpenTofu u otra herramienta de infraestructura como código. PHP-FPM en producción: configurarlo y actualizarlo. Programar en PHP, con Laravel o Symfony, lo bastante para echar una mano en una API: añadir un campo, una función o un endpoint. Haber montado automatizaciones con IA para el trabajo de sistemas, como resumir alertas o preparar un cambio para que una persona lo revise. Haber restaurado copias de seguridad en un entorno real, no solo haberlas configurado. Monitorización y alertas (Prometheus, Grafana o similar). Haber pasado servicios a contenedores. MariaDB, PostgreSQL y RabbitMQ; Ansible; virtualización con Proxmox. No pedimos inglés más allá de leer documentación técnica. Lo que no es este puesto No es soporte a usuarios, ni puestos de trabajo, ni la red de la oficina. No es un puesto de programación: tu trabajo principal es que los demás programen sin pelearse con los servidores. No es empezar de cero: hay mucho montado, y moverlo bien es la mitad del trabajo. Lo que ofrecemos La estabilidad de una empresa con más de 30 años y la forma de trabajar de un equipo que programa con IA cada día. Proyectos pensados para años, en una empresa que no depende de la próxima ronda de financiación. Desde 33.000 € brutos anuales, según experiencia. Contrato indefinido. Jornada intensiva de 8:00 a 16:00: las tardes son tuyas. Desarrollo con IA integrada desde el primer día, con las herramientas a cargo de la empresa. Libertad para crear: si una idea mejora algo, hay margen para probarla. Recorrido: el departamento está creciendo y abre oportunidades de futuro. Presencial en Vila-seca (Tarragona). Trabajo directo con el CTO. El proceso Una conversación de media hora. Una entrevista técnica con casos reales nuestros. Sin pizarra. Una segunda entrevista: te enseñamos nuestro plan y nos dices qué cambiarías. Respondemos a todas las candidaturas, también si no sigues adelante. ¿Dudas antes de inscribirte? Busca al CTO de Elektro3 en LinkedIn y escríbele directamente. Para empezar Cuéntanos en cuatro líneas el sistema más desordenado que te has encontrado y qué hiciste con él. Nos dice más que un currículum.

review_candidates.description: We are Siemens Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing. We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities. In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software. Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities. Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases. Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.
